title: Phonic-1 - caller bol raha hai aur AI pehle se kaam shuru kar deta hai
content:
Aapne kabhi customer care ko call kiya hai
aur AI bolta hai, let me look that up?
Aur phir aap wait karte rehte ho.
Ek naya model is wait ko khatam karna chahta hai.
Iska naam hai Phonic-1.
Phonic naam ki company ne ise 29 October 2026 ko launch kiya.
Saath mein 27.5 million dollar ka Series A bhi announce kiya,
led by First Round.
Company ki total funding ab 31.5 million dollar hai.
Ab ye special kyun hai?
Pehle samjho aaj ke voice agents kaise bante hain.
Most voice agents are built from 3 parts.
1 model caller ki baat ko text mein badalta hai.
2nd model decide karta hai kya jawab dena hai.
3rd model jawab ko awaaz mein bolta hai.
Problem ye hai ki text mein bahut kuch kho jaata hai.
Caller ki awaaz ka frustration,
lamba pause,
naam bolne ka tareeka.
Phonic-1 is a speech-to-speech model.
Ye seedha awaaz se awaaz pe kaam karta hai.
Aur sabse bada claim.
Company kehti hai ki Phonic-1 caller ke bolte bolte hi
tool call kar sakta hai.
Matlab caller ruke, usse pehle answer ready.
Kuch aur numbers, company ke blog se.
Ye 50 se zyada languages pe trained hai.
Aur Sierra ke multilingual voice benchmark pe
company ke hisaab se iska score 83.2 hai,
jabki GPT-Live-1 ka 79.9.
Ye company ke apne claims hain, independent test nahi.
Ab business ke liye iska use kya hai?
Maan lo aapki ek clinic hai.
Patient call karta hai aur appointment badalna chahta hai.
Wo apna naam aur date bol hi raha hai,
aur agent background mein calendar check kar chuka hai.
Call chhoti, patient khush, staff free.
Same cheez delivery tracking, bank queries,
ya hiring screening calls pe bhi lag sakti hai.
Lekin ek honest baat.
Speed hi sab kuch nahi hai.
Before you switch, test it on your real calls.
Check accuracy, cost per minute, aur Hindi ya Hinglish callers ke saath kaisa perform karta hai.
Mera take simple hai.
Voice AI ka next level ye nahi ki awaaz kitni human lagti hai.
Next level ye hai ki agent kitni jaldi KAAM karta hai.
Aur jo log voice agents ko real business workflows se jod sakte hain,
unki demand badhne wali hai.
Comment VOICE and I'll DM you the link.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
